title: Showcase
about: One row of every kind, for the how-to screenshot. Every choice is stored in settings.json (the api binding); nothing in the game is changed.

rows.label: Turn Custom Kicking on to unlock the kicking rows below it.
Custom Kicking
rows.description: On: the kicking rows below apply. Off: they are greyed and the game kicks as normal.

rows.label: Kick Style
rows.description: How the kicker plays field goals and punts.

rows.label: Kick Accuracy Bonus
rows.description: Added to the kicker's accuracy, in percent.

rows.label: Kicker Pressure
rows.description: Shown only while Custom Kicking is on: how much a loud crowd rattles the kicker.

rows.label: Game Speed
rows.description: A slider with a decimal step, from 0.5 x to 2.0 x.
